strings.safety.report.error.reason: Pick a reason for your report.
strings.safety.report.error.noteTooLong: That note is too long. Trim it down a little.
strings.safety.report.error.noteContact: Leave out links, emails, phone numbers, @handles and hidden characters.
strings.safety.report.title: Report @{handle}
strings.safety.report.reason.childSafety: A child may be at risk
strings.safety.report.noteHint: Up to {max} characters. Leave out links, emails, phone numbers and @handles. Some emoji are built from hidden characters, so they can't go in a note either.
strings.safety.report.private: @{handle} won't be told who reported them.
strings.safety.report.conduct: Not sure what counts? Check the {link}.
strings.safety.report.failed: Your report didn't send. Check your connection and try again.
strings.safety.crisis.title: If someone might get hurt, don't wait for us
strings.safety.crisis.body: We review reports, but not in real time. If you or someone else is in danger, reach out now.
strings.safety.crisis.988: Call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (US).
strings.safety.crisis.911: Call 911 if someone is in immediate danger.
strings.safety.crisis.outsideUs: Outside the US, call your local emergency number.
strings.safety.block.title: Block @{handle}?
strings.safety.block.body: You won't see each other anywhere in the city: not on the map, in places, in friends or in chat.
strings.safety.block.ends: Blocking also ends your friendship and any roommate link with them.
strings.safety.block.private: They won't be told you blocked them. You can unblock any time from Me.
strings.safety.toast.muted: @{handle} is muted. Their avatar and emotes are hidden for you.
strings.safety.toast.blockedEnded: @{handle} is blocked. Your friendship and roommate link ended.
strings.safety.toast.restored: @{handle} is unblocked, and what blocking ended is back.
strings.safety.toast.reported: Thanks. Your report about @{handle} is in, and a moderator will look at it.
strings.safety.toast.reportedAgain: You already reported @{handle} for this. A moderator will look at it.
strings.safety.toast.reportedBlocked: Thanks. Your report about @{handle} is in, and they're blocked.
strings.safety.toast.failed: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
strings.safety.list.title: Blocked and muted
strings.safety.list.explain: Blocked players can't see you, and you can't see them. Muted players stay in the city, but their avatar and emotes are hidden for you.
strings.safety.list.failed: Your blocked and muted lists didn't load.
strings.safety.list.loading: Loading your blocked and muted lists
strings.safety.notice.title: A message from the moderators
strings.safety.notice.warning: A moderator reviewed a report about your account and gave you a warning.
strings.safety.notice.handleReset: A moderator reset your handle. You've got a new one; you can pick another from Me.
strings.safety.notice.restriction: A moderator limited your account: no friends, friend boosts, chat or emotes for now.
strings.safety.notice.suspension: A moderator suspended your account. Other players can't see you, and you can't interact with them for now.
strings.safety.notice.ban: A moderator banned your account from the shared city. You can still play solo on this device.
strings.safety.notice.appealUpheld: We looked at your appeal again. The decision stands.
strings.safety.notice.appealOverturned: We looked at your appeal again and reversed the decision. Sorry about that.
strings.safety.notice.conduct: Read the {link} to see what's allowed.
strings.safety.notice.appealLabel: Tell us why you think this was a mistake
strings.safety.notice.appealHint: Up to {max} characters. A moderator who didn't make the decision reads it.
strings.safety.notice.appealSent: Your appeal is in. We'll tell you here what we decide.
strings.safety.notice.appealEmpty: Write a few words about why this was a mistake.
strings.safety.notice.appealTooLong: That appeal is too long. Trim it down a little.
strings.safety.notice.failed: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
strings.safety.rpc.notAuthenticated: You're not signed in to the city right now. Reload the page to reconnect.
strings.safety.rpc.attestationRequired: Finish the welcome card before you go online.
strings.safety.rpc.notAdult: The shared city is for adults only.
strings.safety.rpc.invalidTimestamp: Your device clock looks off. Check it and try again.
strings.safety.rpc.invalidArgument: Something about that request wasn't right. Try again.
strings.safety.rpc.notFriends: You're not friends with that player.
strings.safety.rpc.boostAlreadySent: You already sent them a boost today.
strings.safety.rpc.rateLimited: Slow down a sec. Try again in a minute.
strings.safety.rpc.handleInvalid: That handle doesn't fit the rules.
strings.safety.rpc.handleNotAllowed: That handle isn't allowed here. Pick something else.
strings.safety.rpc.handleTaken: That handle is taken. Try another one.
strings.safety.rpc.handleChangeLimited: You changed your handle recently. Try again later.
strings.safety.rpc.tooManyIds: Too many players at once. Try again.
strings.safety.rpc.accountBanned: Your account is banned from the shared city. You can still play solo.
strings.safety.rpc.accountSuspended: Your account is suspended for now, so you can't do that.
strings.safety.rpc.accountRestricted: Your account is limited for now, so you can't do that.
strings.safety.rpc.blockLimit: You've hit the block limit. Unblock someone from Me first.
strings.safety.rpc.muteLimit: You've hit the mute limit. Unmute someone from Me first.
strings.safety.rpc.invalidReason: Pick a reason for your report.
strings.safety.rpc.noteTooLong: That note is too long. Trim it down a little.
strings.safety.rpc.noteContactInfo: Leave out links, emails, phone numbers, @handles and hidden characters.
strings.safety.rpc.appealTooLong: That appeal is too long. Trim it down a little.
strings.safety.rpc.appealExists: You already appealed this decision. We'll tell you what we decide.
strings.safety.rpc.idempotencyConflict: That action clashed with another one. Reload and try again.
strings.safety.rpc.revisionConflict: Your save changed somewhere else. Reload to get the latest one.
strings.safety.rpc.versionRegressed: Your account has a save from a newer version of the game. Reload to update.
strings.safety.rpc.unknown: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
